ModMetaData.name: Smokehouse
ModMetaData.author: rukwle9uyq
ModMetaData.description:
Adds a wood-fired smokehouse and a small line of cured provisions.
Pemmican is the only travel food a low-tech colony can make, and it needs both meat and vegetables on hand. Smokehouse fills that gap: a single-ingredient preservation bench that runs on wood instead of power, so a hunting colony, a desert outpost or a gravship galley can turn a surplus of one food type into rations that keep for a season.
- New research: smoke preserving (Neolithic, 600 points) - New building: smokehouse, 2x1, wood-fired, no electricity - New bills: smoke meat, dry vegetables - New items: smoked meat and dried vegetables, light, stack to 75, keep for 45-60 days - Small mood bonus when a colonist eats cured provisions
No C# and no DLC required. Safe to add to an existing save; removing it mid-save will drop the smokehouse and any cured food still on the map.
